US DOJ Probes TV Networks Over White House Pool Coverage Halt

The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) is investigating whether the halt in White House television pool coverage violated antitrust laws. The probe specifically examines the response of major TV networks to a White House ban on CNN's coverage. The DOJ is looking into potential antitrust violations related to this incident.
